#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 260000;
int n, k, mod;
int dp[18][MAXN];
int fac[MAXN], inv[MAXN], pc[MAXN];
bool seen[MAXN];

int power(int a, int e) {
    if (e == 0) return 1;
    int r = power(a, e / 2);
    r = (int)(1LL * r * r % mod);
    if (e & 1) r = (int)(1LL * r * a % mod);
    return r;
}

struct Solver {
    int run() {
        scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &k, &mod);
        if (n & 1) {
            printf("%d\n", power(k, n));
            return 0;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (i == 0) fac[i] = 1;
            else fac[i] = (int)(1LL * fac[i - 1] * i % mod);
        }
        inv[n] = power(fac[n], mod - 2);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            inv[i] = (int)(1LL * inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);

        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            pc[i] = 0;
            for (int x = i; x; x &= x - 1) ++pc[i];
        }
        for (int i = n;; i = (i - 1) & n) {
            seen[i] = true;
            if (i == 0) break;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (!seen[i]) continue;
            for (int j = i; j > 0; j = (j - 1) & i) {
                int lim = min(k, pc[i - j] + 1);
                for (int s = 1; s <= lim; ++s) {
                    if (dp[s - 1][i - j]) {
                        dp[s][i] = (int)((dp[s][i] + 1LL * dp[s - 1][i - j] * inv[j]) % mod);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= min(k, pc[n]); ++i) {
            if (dp[i][n]) {
                int tmp = (int)(1LL * dp[i][n] * fac[k] % mod);
                tmp = (int)(1LL * tmp * inv[k - i] % mod);
                tmp = (int)(1LL * tmp * inv[i] % mod);
                tmp = (int)(1LL * tmp * fac[n] % mod);
                ans = (ans + tmp) % mod;
            }
        }
        printf("%d\n", (power(k, n) - ans + mod) % mod);
        return 0;
    }
};

int main() {
    Solver solver;
    return solver.run();
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 260000;
int n, k, mod;
int memo[18][MAXN];
int fact[MAXN], invFact[MAXN], pcnt[MAXN];

int power(int a, int e) {
    if (e == 0) return 1;
    int r = power(a, e / 2);
    r = (int)(1LL * r * r % mod);
    if (e & 1) r = (int)(1LL * r * a % mod);
    return r;
}

int calc_dp(int s, int mask) {
    if (s == 0) return mask == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    int &res = memo[s][mask];
    if (res != -1) return res;
    res = 0;
    for (int j = mask; j; j = (j - 1) & mask) {
        int lim = min(k, pcnt[mask - j] + 1);
        if (s <= lim) {
            int nxt = calc_dp(s - 1, mask - j);
            if (nxt) {
                res = (res + (long long)nxt * invFact[j]) % mod;
            }
        }
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &k, &mod);
    if (n & 1) {
        printf("%d\n", power(k, n));
        return 0;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (i == 0) fact[i] = 1;
        else fact[i] = (int)(1LL * fact[i - 1] * i % mod);

    invFact[n] = power(fact[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i)
        invFact[i] = (int)(1LL * invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        pcnt[i] = 0;
        for (int x = i; x; x &= x - 1) ++pcnt[i];
    }

    fill(&memo[0][0], &memo[0][0] + 18 * MAXN, -1);

    int ans = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s <= min(k, pcnt[n]); ++s) {
        int val = calc_dp(s, n);
        if (val) {
            long long tmp = (long long)val * fact[k] % mod;
            tmp = tmp * invFact[k - s] % mod;
            tmp = tmp * invFact[s] % mod;
            tmp = tmp * fact[n] % mod;
            ans = (ans + (int)tmp) % mod;
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", (power(k, n) - ans + mod) % mod);
    return 0;
}
